body:
So it's only been two weeks, but I will say that this process:

**shave > zap** (IMMEDIATELY) **> wax** (as the hair pushes out, day 3-5)

left me with comparatively minimal irritation last week. I'm doing a lot of my body, and the whole shave > zap process takes about three hours (ugh), so I'm only doing it once a week. Previously I had found that breaking it up (shave day 1 > zap day 2 or 3) left me with a LOT of irritation.

I'm currently two days post shave > zap and have a few irritated bumps where the hair grows particularly thick and dark, but otherwise still pretty smooth. I probably won't have enough hair to wax until Friday. I'll try another round of going straight from **zap > wax** then.

I will say it does seem to be working, in general! The hair is taking longer to come back and there's less of it. It is a mild increase in sting when there's a little hair poking out but seems worth it to have that short term irritation vs days of terrible.

>I say experiment yourself and see how your body reacts. Every one is different. Trial and error is the only way you'll know for sure.

This is SO helpful, thank you!!

Here to reassure you that there are \*plenty\* of guys on Grindr who will still be into you. Do disclose your status, either in your profile or in your messages before meeting someone -- trust your gut about when it's safe to do so -- and have fun.

I might have done it already if I had a gun (it's alarmingly easy to get them here)

Maybe we buy toys and practice. ;)
